title: mediocre
description: a really mediocre modpack that adds tech and automation stuff!
body:
a collection of mods i think are pretty cool!

# features
- build massive storage networks with AE2!
- build factories to fill said storage networks
- money!
- crafting recipes to link them all together!
- also you can craft instruments now
- mods
- more mods
- a lot of mods
- actually there's only 66 mods but thats a lot for some ppls standards
- i already mentioned this modpack has mods right?
- yeah i did
